title: Restore stock shock damping

applicability.included: Exact standard US 2023 Yamaha YZ250F with original stock suspension.
excluded: Other years, modified valving, replacement shock/fork assemblies or springs
Spring preload changes or internal shock service

entry_state: Assembled bike with identified original components and serviceable suspension.
exit_state: All three shock damping controls restored and recorded; functional checks complete.
preflight: Use the exact-year diagrams to identify the adjusters and measurement points.
Record current setup before changing it; do not force an adjuster past its stop.
critical_stop_conditions: Unidentified component or adjuster; leaks, damage or binding; target setting cannot be reached within actual travel.

required_tools.name: Suitable rebound/low-speed driver and high-speed adjuster tool

source.review_note: Root independent review approved exact-year settings and diagrams; assembled preload access prerequisite preserved. Physical validation remains outstanding.

steps.title: Check shock and linkage
steps.instruction: Support the bike upright on level ground. Inspect the shock for gas/oil leakage, then sit astride the seat and move up and down to check shock and linkage action. Repair leaks or unsmooth action before setup.
verification: Save the actual measurements or setting and outcome.

steps.title: Record the starting controls
steps.instruction: Raise the rear wheel securely. Identify bottom rebound, outer high-speed compression and inner low-speed compression using the diagrams. Gently move each toward full hard (a), counting and recording its original clicks or turns. Do not force stops.
verification: Save the actual measurements or setting and outcome.

steps.title: Set shock rebound
steps.instruction: Turn the rebound adjuster outward from full hard in direction b by 10 clicks. Nominal range is 0–30 clicks; respect the actual mechanical limit.
verification: Save the actual measurements or setting and outcome.

steps.title: Set high-speed compression
steps.instruction: Turn the high-speed compression adjuster outward from gently seated full hard in direction b by 7/8 turn(s). Count turns, not clicks. Nominal range is 0–2 turns; never force the stop.
verification: Save the actual measurements or setting and outcome.

steps.title: Set low-speed compression
steps.instruction: Turn the separate low-speed compression screw outward from full hard in direction b by 8 clicks. Nominal range is 0–20 clicks; actual travel can differ slightly.
verification: Save the actual measurements or setting and outcome.

steps.title: Check the rear baseline
steps.instruction: Lower the bike securely and recheck smooth suspension action. Save rebound 10 clicks, high-speed compression 7/8 turns and low-speed compression 8 clicks out, plus any remaining symptom. Spring preload has not changed.
verification: Save the actual measurements or setting and outcome.

completeness: All three shock damping controls restored and recorded; functional checks complete.
